Frequently asked questions

Is SimpanClip free?

Yes. It is free and needs no account.

Which videos and photos can I download?

Public videos and photos from Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. Photo posts can't always be fetched, depending on the platform. Private content, videos that need a login, and live streams still in progress can't be downloaded.

How do I download on iPhone?

Use Safari. When processing finishes, tap the download icon in Safari, then open the file in the Files app. From there you can share it or save it to Photos.

Can I download other people's videos?

Only for personal use and with the owner's permission. Don't re-upload someone else's video as your own. You are responsible for how you use what you download.

Does SimpanClip store my videos?

No. Files exist on the server only while your download is processed and are deleted automatically within 10 minutes. We have no accounts and don't log the links you paste.

Why did my download fail?

Common causes: a wrong link, a private or deleted video, or the platform limiting access. Copy the link again, or try again in a few minutes.
